Any maximum abelian subalgebra contains entire center Z and becomes an ideal; RREF pivot vertices of commuting d-plane are an independent set, giving d<=alpha(G), attained by a maximum independent coordinate plane, total dimension m+alpha(G). Fix pivot S: maximal independent sets dominate all nonpivots. Edge equations force nonpivot column either zero (two pivot neighbors) or t_v e_{s(v)} (unique pivot neighbor); echelon orientation allows only s(v)<v. Remaining edge equations are precisely squarefree products t_ut_v when adjacent u,v have different pivot owners, making each chart a reduced Stanley–Reisner coordinate arrangement over arbitrary k. Over F_q, nonzero supports independent in H_S yield sum_S I_H(q-1). Witness K3 disjoint K1 vs P4: same ordinary independence polynomial but different Grassmann/Plücker loci P² vs meeting P¹s, counts q²+q+1 and 2q+1. Independently enumerated 150 graph-field combinations (all labeled graphs through 4 vertices over F2,F3) using RREF and direct bracket checks; exact agreement. Finite checks corroborate the all-graph scheme argument.
